marker: # unit_length, ref_size and ref_repeats are the published values that the MLVAbank identifier in
# the label column encodes as NAME_<unit>bp_<size>bp_<n>u. They are the same numbers as in the
# bundled scheme bacillus_mlva31_mlvabank, whose source table supplied them, so no number in
# this table is derived.
# ref_size is also the product length measured in the Ames Ancestor assembly GCA_000008445.1 by
# in silico PCR with these primers, outer primer edge to outer primer edge: all eight agree with
# the identifier, every locus gives exactly one product, all are searchable at word size 11, none
# needs the rescue pass and none has a primer mismatch. The genomic locations published by Van
# Ert et al. 2007 span exactly these eight sizes as well. The six chromosomal loci lie on
# AE017334.2, pXO1-aat on pXO1 (AE017336.2) and pXO2-at on pXO2 (AE017335.3), as their names
# state.
# The first version of this scheme derived the unit lengths and copy numbers from the reference,
# because the primer table of Keim et al. 2000 carries no amplicon sizes, unit lengths or allele
# definitions, and it warned that a derived count could be offset from the canonical allele. The
# published values show how far that went: the derived count was right at vrrA (4), CG3 (2) and
# pXO1-aat (7) and wrong at the other five. pXO2-at was out by one, 10 TA units counted where the
# panel numbers the reference 9. vrrB1 and vrrB2 were badly out, 3 and 2 counted against 20 and
# 13, because their 9 bp arrays are degenerate and only the clean core was counted. vrrC1 and
# vrrC2 were counted on the 36 bp higher-order period that their arrays also show, 7 and 8 units
# of 36 bp, where the panel numbers them on a 9 bp and an 18 bp unit, 53 and 17 units. An allele
# in this panel is therefore not always a literal count of whole units in the reference.
# patterns are kept only for the three loci whose published copy number equals the number of
# times the published motif occurs in the reference, so the tandem array cross-check is active on
# those three and skipped on the rest, where it would contradict the published number. The motifs
# are those published by Van Ert et al. 2007, who carry these loci forward; CG3 is stored in the
# published rotation TAATA. That paper describes vrrB1 as a 9 bp degenerate repeat and vrrB2,
# vrrC1 and vrrC2 as Complex, which is what the reference shows.
# vrrB1 and vrrB2 hold 20 and 13 units of 9 bp in a 229 and a 153 bp product, which leaves 49 and
# 36 bp outside the array, less than their two primers occupy, so for these two loci the primers
# lie inside the repeat array. The allele formula is unaffected because it needs only the size
# and the copy number to be consistent, which they are.
# vrrB1 and vrrB2 are adjacent paralogues whose amplicons overlap by 27 bp, and vrrC1 and vrrC2
# likewise overlap by 36 bp, so a rearrangement in either region can move both members of a pair.
# vrrA has a fifth, divergent 12 bp copy immediately upstream of the four the panel counts
# (CAATATCGACAG, 3 differences), which the published copy number of 4 does not include.
